c=ε0=μ0=1。無限円柱のEz偏光、半径0.25、比誘電率2.25、真空波長1。6×6領域と4辺PML、明示的な節点階段状形状です。 編集上の補足 Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。 図の中央の白抜きは診断用のr<0.4のマスクで、物理円柱の半径0.25とは区別します。 採用した計算法 Yeeの散乱場を局所分極contrastの厳密な離散入射差分で励起します。EとHはそれぞれの整数・半時刻でFourier集計し、Hの4点補間後に物理流束を積分します。 ε∂tEz=∂xHy−∂yHx,∂tHx=−∂yEz,∂tHy=∂xEzε∂t​Ez​=∂x​Hy​−∂y​Hx​,∂t​Hx​=−∂y​Ez​,∂t​Hy​=∂x​Ez​ Results and verificationMethods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Use c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, an infinite cylinder with Ez polarization, radius 0.25, relative permittivity 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The 6 × 6 domain has four-side PML and an explicitly nodal staircase geometry. Editorial clarification This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials. The central white region is a diagnostic mask at r<0.4, distinct from the physical cylinder radius0.25. Adopted numerical method Advance the scattered Yee fields with an exact discrete incident difference on the polarization-contrast support. Accumulate E and H at their own integer and half times, then integrate physical power after four-point native-face collocation. ε∂tEz=∂xHy−∂yHx,∂tHx=−∂yEz,∂tHy=∂xEzε∂t​Ez​=∂x​Hy​−∂y​Hx​,∂t​Hx​=−∂y​Ez​,∂t​Hy​=∂x​Ez​ Σsca=4k∑n=−∞∞∣an∣2,Σext=−4k∑nRe⁡anΣsca​=k4​n=−∞∑∞​∣an​∣2,Σext​=−k4​n∑​Rean​ References and measured quantities Use 12/18/24 points per wavelength, 32 burn-in periods and 8 measured periods. Check two contours, consecutive four-period windows, half-amplitude phasors after a complete repeated evolution, and a vacuum control at the five saved times.
